resources.string: Use Google\'s document scanner, run by Google Play services.
Needs Google Play services, which this device does not have.
Shares titles, dates and totals only, never images or full text.
This app has no network permission and cannot send anything anywhere.
No analytics, no accounts, no cloud.
Documents, text and exports stay in the app\'s private storage until you share them yourself.
Text recognition and edge detection run on this device.
Quick scan is optional: Google Play services runs it, and may fetch its own model.
